about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a fullstack developer and systems programmer with a passion for building everything from APIs and emulators to interactive game experiences. At anevis solutions, I worked extensively with Java and the Spring framework to develop reporting platforms, maintain PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases, and optimize CI/CD pipelines. Beyond professional work, I design complex backend systems for games, including custom rendering pipelines, real-time shaders, and narrative engines in Unity and WebGL. My personal projects span a variety of technologies, including C/C++, Zig, HLSL, and low-level system programming, showcasing both my versatility and technical depth. I enjoy tackling performance-critical problems, experimenting with new technologies, and creating experiences that blend technical rigor with engaging interactivity. Explore my projects to see how my backend expertise powers gameplay, simulations, and interactive applications directly in the browser.
paragraphs: I'm a fullstack developer with a strong backend foundation. I build web applications end-to-end: from data models, databases and APIs to responsive user interfaces, deployment and CI/CD.

At anevis solutions, I developed reporting platforms with Java and the Spring framework, maintained PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases, and implemented CI/CD pipelines. This experience underpins the robust, maintainable applications I build across the stack.

Across personal and commercial projects, I connect backend systems with modern web interfaces. I work with technologies including TypeScript, React, Next.js, Astro and Contentful and take ownership from concept through implementation and release.

Low-level developer tooling, emulators and interactive applications complement my fullstack profile. They sharpen my approach to clean architecture, performance and dependable software beyond conventional web development.

joyboy.title: JoyBoy
joyboy.description: A Game Boy emulator written in Go, featuring an interactive debugger and OpenGL rendering.
joyboy.fullDescription: JoyBoy is a Game Boy emulator written in Go, released as version 0.1. It emulates the LR35902 CPU with a No-MBC (32 KiB) cartridge setup and renders frames in OpenGL using GLFW and Dear ImGui. It ships with an interactive debugger that lets you pause, single-step and restart the emulated CPU, and the joypad maps to keyboard controls. JoyBoy is verified with hand-tested Tetris and Dr. Mario ROMs and is built from a hardcoded ROM path - a full cartridge and sound implementation is planned for future versions.

imagesCaptions.tetris: Tetris running on the JoyBoy emulator
imagesCaptions.debugger: The interactive debugger: set breakpoints by clicking memory cells, restart (F7), single-step (F5) and fast-step (F6) through code, inspect CPU registers and memory regions, and view the VRAM Tile Viewer, Background and Window maps, and the Object (sprite) viewer.

features.cpuEmulationDesc: Emulation of the LR35902 CPU (Sharp SM83 core) with a No-MBC 32 KiB cartridge setup.
features.debuggerDesc: Set breakpoints by clicking memory cells, restart, single-step and fast-step the emulated CPU live, and inspect registers and memory.
features.vramViewersDesc: GPU-accelerated tile, background, window and object (sprite) viewers that render live VRAM contents into the debugger.
features.frameRendererDesc: Reconstructs the background, window and object layers and uploads the complete frame at VBlank, rendered in OpenGL via GLFW and Dear ImGui.

c8-serenityos.title: CHIP-8 Emulator for SerenityOS
c8-serenityos.description: A CHIP-8 emulator implementation built specifically for the SerenityOS operating system.
c8-serenityos.fullDescription: This project is a complete CHIP-8 emulator developed for SerenityOS, featuring accurate CPU emulation, graphics rendering, and sound support. CHIP-8 is a simple virtual machine designed in the 1970s for programming games, and this emulator brings those classic games to the modern SerenityOS platform with pixel-perfect accuracy.

features.cpuEmulationDesc: Precise implementation of the CHIP-8 instruction set with adjustable timing controls and proper register handling.
features.graphicsRenderingDesc: Pixel-perfect 64x32 monochrome display rendering with scalable resolution support for crisp visuals at any size.
features.soundSystemDesc: Authentic beep sound generation matching the original CHIP-8 specifications.
features.crossPlatformDevDesc: Developed specifically for SerenityOS, demonstrating adaptability to esoteric operating systems and diverse development environments.

spring-library-api.title: Spring Library Management API
spring-library-api.description: A comprehensive REST API for library management built with Spring Boot and Java.
spring-library-api.fullDescription: This project is a full-featured library management system backend built with Spring Boot. It provides REST API endpoints for managing books, authors, borrowers, and lending operations. The system includes proper data validation, exception handling, and follows REST principles for clean API design. Perfect for learning Spring Boot concepts or as a foundation for larger library management systems.

socket-fun.title: Socket Experiments
socket-fun.description: Experimenting with sockets in C on Linux, featuring echo and chat servers with concurrent connection handling.
socket-fun.fullDescription: Socket Experiments is a learning project that explores socket programming in C on Linux. It includes both an Echo Server/Client and Chat Server/Client implementation, demonstrating concurrent connection handling using epoll(). The project showcases low-level network programming concepts and efficient I/O multiplexing techniques for handling multiple client connections simultaneously.

imageCaptions.title: Socket Experiments project title and overview

imageCaptions.chatServer: Chat server handling multiple clients simultaneously

features.echoServerDesc: TCP Echo Server that reflects client messages back, demonstrating basic client-server communication patterns.
features.chatServerDesc: Multi-client chat server enabling real-time communication between connected clients.
features.concurrentConnectionsDesc: Support for up to 128 simultaneous client connections using efficient I/O multiplexing.
features.epollHandlingDesc: High-performance event-driven I/O using Linux epoll() for scalable network applications.

world-launcher.title: World-Launcher
world-launcher.description: A Windows launcher for Super Mario World ROM hacks with integrated patching capabilities using Floating IPS.
world-launcher.fullDescription: World-Launcher is a comprehensive Windows application designed for Super Mario World ROM hack enthusiasts. It combines ROM patching functionality with a user-friendly launcher interface, allowing users to easily patch ROM files with .bps or .ips patches and launch them directly in their preferred SNES emulator. The application integrates Floating IPS by Alcaro for reliable ROM patching and provides seamless emulator integration for an enhanced gaming experience.

shared-aesthetic.description: AI-powered cross-media recommendation website based on 'vibes' and artistic aesthetics.
shared-aesthetic.fullDescription: Shared Aesthetic is a cross-media discovery web application that bridges Books, Movies, and Games using shared artistic 'vibes'. By leveraging vector embeddings (PostgreSQL) and semantic analysis (Gemini AI), the platform finds hidden connections between different media types, allowing users to find a movie that feels like their favorite book or a game that matches a specific aesthetic.

pirate-game-jam-2025.title: Living Armory
pirate-game-jam-2025.description: A Unity WebGL game developed for the Pirate Software Game Jam 2025, playable directly in your browser.
pirate-game-jam-2025.fullDescription: Living Armory puts you in control of weapons themselves as you navigate a mysterious dungeon. Built around the game jam theme 'You are the weapon', you possess and control different weapons to fight enemies and interact with the environment. As a metroidbrainia game, your progression speed is limited by your knowledge of the game world - can you find the fastest way out of the dungeon? Created for Pirate Software Game Jam 2025, this Unity WebGL experience challenges players to master both combat and puzzle-solving through weapon possession.

spitting-sugar.fullDescription: Spitting Sugar is an innovative first-person puzzle game inspired by Portal's mechanics. Players use unique sweet-spitting abilities to build bridges, defeat enemies, and solve complex puzzles. Developed during a game jam using Unity, this creative project showcases inventive gameplay mechanics and clever level design that transforms simple projectiles into versatile problem-solving tools. bachelor-thesis.title: Rendering classic hand-drawn cartoon animations
bachelor-thesis.description: My Bachelor's thesis: A technical exploration of 3D recreation of classic 2D animations using custom Unity shaders and render pipeline.
bachelor-thesis.fullDescription: This Bachelor's thesis project explores the technical challenges and artistic possibilities of recreating classic hand-drawn cartoon animations in a 3D environment. Using Unity's programmable render pipeline and custom HLSL shaders, the project demonstrates innovative approaches to maintaining the distinctive visual style of traditional 2D animation while leveraging the advantages of 3D rendering. The work includes detailed analysis of animation principles, shader development, and render pipeline customization to achieve authentic cartoon aesthetics in three-dimensional space.

kalos.description: An interactive narrative game created for the 'Interactive Stories and Playable Narratives' university module.
kalos.fullDescription: KALOS tells the compelling story of young Nuria, who is sent on a divine mission by the god of the temple her family guards. But as the narrative unfolds, not everything is as it seems. This interactive story was developed as part of the university module 'Interactive Stories and Playable Narratives', showcasing advanced narrative design, voice acting, and multiple branching storylines that respond to player choices.
